The '''Veil Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was inhabited by giant [[Neebray/Legends|neebray]].<ref name="TCW12" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] kept the secret headquarters of his [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|squadron]], [[Harko Station]], within it.<ref name="TCW11" />
